lammps.title: LAMMPS / BRACED NETWORK
lammps.subtitle: 64 sites / 441 bonds / saved SI dynamics
lammps.scope: Synthetic harmonic bonded-network benchmark; not atomistic material calibration or a general BPM validation. Initial strained state relaxes dynamically.
boundaries: Visualization uses the finest saved n400 run; n100 and n200 are separate stored levels, not recomputed here.
A short saved time window does not establish long-time stability or broad material validity.
Pin joints and phantom crossings; no contact, bending, chemistry or material calibration.
Recorded checks include saved-frame mechanics, adjacent-step Verlet residuals and common-time refinement; full propagated NumPy reference arrays were not retained for independent reintegration.
lammps.display: Fixed camera. x_display = x_initial + 1000 * (x_saved - x_initial). Gray lines show the initial saved geometry. Colors show unamplified displacement magnitude. Loop restart is a playback reset, not simulated reverse motion.
lammps.parameters: Synthetic benchmark inputs, not experimental calibration.

taichi.title: TAICHI / HETEROGENEOUS NETWORK
taichi.subtitle: 4,340 nodes / 5,073 edges / saved axial dynamics
taichi.scope: Synthetic nondimensional axial mass-network benchmark, 1,600 integration steps; no GPU performance claim.
boundaries: Only nine saved states are available; no interpolated states are presented.
Cutoff checks are sampled only. Work ledger was not collected; energy curves do not demonstrate energy balance under forcing.
Original CPU runtime reported subnormal half-value flushing after initialization; that process-level behavior is not validated by a visualization.
Backend parity on saved states is not independent validation of the physical constitutive law.
taichi.display: Fixed camera. x_display = x_initial + 1000 * (x_saved - x_initial). Gray lines show the initial saved geometry. Colors show unamplified displacement magnitude. Loop restart is a playback reset, not simulated reverse motion.
taichi.parameters: Synthetic benchmark inputs, not experimental calibration.
